definitions: A condition in which fluid accumulates in the brain, typically in young children, enlarging the head and sometimes causing brain damage.
An abnormal increase in the amount of cerebrospinal fluid within the ventricles of the brain, causing the head to enlarge and the brain to be compressed.
examples: The infant was diagnosed with hydrocephalus shortly after birth.
Surgery is often required to treat hydrocephalus.
Untreated hydrocephalus can lead to developmental delays.
